from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's total liabilities from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code if provided (e.g., 300581, 300221)")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported total liabilities amount (负债合计)")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line label as written in the document (e.g., '负债合计')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this liability figure")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document containing this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
